linkedin:
According to Loker Dollar's remote-job listings, only 22% of active listings state a pay figure. The rest are marked DOE (determined on experience), leaving you to guess the USD salary that could match your expertise.

With 4,280 active remote listings, 940 disclose a salary, while 3,340 hide it. 64% accept applicants from any country, and 1,213 were posted in the last 7 days. For example, Online Consumer Panels America offers $25–$45/hour for product assessments.

DOE isn't always a red flag—it can be a negotiation lever. Use global benchmarks and quantify your impact to anchor high. Browse the latest DOE listings on Loker Dollar and start the conversation today.
